scenario: A cart horse has thrown a shoe on a rocky trail and the cart is too heavy to push uphill alone.
instruction_frame: a request to sketch out what happens when the character shows up
instruction: Can you sketch out what happens when Tom comes across someone struggling with a lame cart horse on a hill?
response:
Tom rounded the bend and saw the cart tilted awkwardly on the rocky trail, its horse favoring one hoof. A woman stood beside it, wiping her brow.

"Thrown a shoe," she said when he approached. "Can't get the cart up the hill like this."

Tom knelt and examined the hoof, then glanced at the load. "If you can lead him steady, I'll push from behind. We'll get you to the top, then you're only a mile from the smithy."

She nodded gratefully. Tom positioned himself at the back of the cart, bracing his shoulder against the worn wood. The woman clicked her tongue and the horse stepped forward carefully. Tom pushed, boots finding purchase on the loose stones. His breathing came harder as the incline steepened, but he kept his weight into it, steady and even.

At the crest, he stepped back as the horse found level ground.

"Thank you," the woman said.

Tom nodded, brushing dust from his hands. "Road's smooth from here. Take care with him."

He turned back the way he'd come, leaving her to continue on.
